name: [🌋] Timber! 🌲🪓
desc:
👋 Welcome to Timber! 🌲

🚨USE CODE: SUMMER26

🪓 Chop down trees!
🌱 Move them to your plot!
💰 Earn $ to buy new axes! 
🦫 Hatch tree-chopping beavers!
🏗️ Build machines and expand your empire!

✨ 300+ Rare Trees to find!

HOW TO CHOP:
🍀 Walk up to a tree and click/tap to chop! Aim for green for increased luck! Or turn on Auto Chop to cut without the clicks!

Made with ❤️ by Juno & Robbie

scripts.title: Auto Chop Farm Harvest and Auto Sell
scripts.features:
Timber Script by Vaan (v2.3.0)

All-in-one Timber helper with a clean UI and smart automation:
- Auto Farm
- Auto Walk Farm
- Farm Anti-Stuck
- Hard Lock Tree
- Multi Zone Farm
- Tree Filter
- Priority Target
- Auto Skip Conflict Tree
- Auto Skip Owner Tree
- Auto Skip Nearby Player
- Auto Skip Robux Popup
- Weather Mutation Hunt
- Auto Harvest
- Auto Sell
- Sell All
- Sell by Filter
- Hotbar Auto Cleanup
- Trees-Only Inventory Select
- Basic Axe Crate Block
- Discord Webhook
- Teleport Zones
- Palm Cove Teleport
- Timber Town Return
- ESP Tree
- Force Tree Info
- Auto Click / Auto Tap
- WalkSpeed / Fly / NoClip Utility
- FPS Boost
- Auto Execute Loader

Hotkeys:
  - F = Toggle Auto Click
  - K = Toggle Auto Farm
- Auto Save config (zone, radius, sell settings, UI state)
